description: Probed at 492b32fe1 for fz-sc8.18: 'defstruct path: nil, modes: [:raw, :read_ahead, :binary]' is error[parse/expected-token]: expected '[', got KwKey("path"). Only the list form 'defstruct [:a, :b]' parses, and every field of a %S{} literal must then be given. Elixir accepts a keyword list of defaults and fills omitted fields from it. fz-sc8.18 fills every File.Stream field explicitly because of this. Parse the keyword form, carry the defaults on the struct's schema, apply them in %S{} construction, with oracle fixtures on all three paths; then File.stream!/1 can drop its explicit defaults.
